title: 第25章 暗杀来袭第26章 段皇剑
slug: 黑化后我称霸三千大世界
lines: 随着凌浩超越了极境，整个秘境的修士纷纷赶往凌浩所在的地方赶去，就连一些开了智的妖兽也往凌浩的方向赶去
而秘境湖中心处
叶辰始终看着凌浩所在的方向所遥望，脸上充满了疑惑，但又不知道找不到原因，为什么自己对这个动静很是不喜，甚至还有嫉妒的冲动
“天老，你说这是突破极境才有的现象，那我突破炼气期极境是不是也会发生类似的现象”
叶辰看着旁边的天老道
“不错，但除了这样还远远不够，因为还需要渡劫，紫雷神劫”
天老看着秘境深处道
“紫雷神劫？”
叶辰听到后瞬间有点胆怯着，而后再一次看向秘境深处的那束直冲九天云霄的百丈金光
紫雷神劫乃是万道大劫，一共有十九道紫雷，每一道紫雷都蕴含着一种大道法则，每降下一道威力增加一分，渡过此劫，未来前途不可限量，渡不过则是身死道消，永生永世再无轮回，能引起紫雷神劫的天才都是三千大世界数一数二的绝世天骄
而此时秘境外的虚空上，开始聚集了浓厚的乌云，乌云之中伴随着紫色雷电，不停的在乌云中轰轰轰做响
因为凌浩所在的位置是秘境当中，紫雷神劫劈不进去，也感应不到凌浩的位置，只能不断的在虚空上聚集，等待凌浩的出现
秘境深处内
凌浩盘坐着，整个人散发着金色的光芒，宛如太阳之子，一旁的太古祖龙看着地上未消耗的天材地宝，于是收进储物戒里，虽然没什么用，但也不能浪费
“看小青莲的样子，已经稳定下来了”
太古祖龙看着盘坐的凌浩道，而走向洞府外
“你们注意周围的情况，小青莲现在在稳定根基，不能受到任何人打扰，一但有打扰者，直接杀”
太古祖龙看着眼前的六十四帝卫道，眼神中充满了杀意，如今认凌浩为主，那么就一定要保证凌浩的安全，不管是谁，他都会杀
六十四帝卫点头道，本来六十四帝卫根本不需要听太古祖龙的命令，但是按照如今的情况，为了保证凌浩的安全，只是暂时听命太古祖龙的话
而一边的白泽则是严肃的站立着，做好了随时战斗的准备，反正有六十四帝卫在，随随便便一个人就可以碾压秘境中的任何修士
秘境外
瞬间出现七位修士，每一个修士身上都散发着可怕的气息，也伴随着恐怖的煞气，根本不是真武大陆所拥有的，就好像是外来者
“殿主大人，按照消息的可靠性，凌家神子和六十四帝卫就在里面，而且里面刚刚发生了不小的动静，恐怕虚空上的乌云就是那个动静引来的”
一名身穿黑色长袍单膝下跪道，而他眼前站立着一个雄伟的中年男子，他浑身散发着碾压虚空的威压，一身黑紫色的铠甲让他显的更加恐怖，他就是三千大世界的魔神宗七杀首领，煞龙天
“好好好，今天就是凌家神子的死期”
煞龙天脸色阴暗的笑道，眼神充满着对鲜血的渴望，身上的煞气瞬间笼罩周边
“走，我们进去”
随后煞龙天率先进入秘境之中，而身后的六人也跟着煞龙天进入秘境之中
在几公里外的山顶上，站立十三名身穿青白道袍的修士，他们身上所散发的气息也是极其强大的，为首的老者身上却无一丝气息，就如同凡人
他们就青霄仙宫的青霞卫
“青长老，魔神宗的人已经进入秘境了，我们是否也紧跟随后？”
一名身穿青白道袍的男子鞠躬着道
“我们不急，先人魔神宗的去消耗六十四帝卫的力气，再让那些与我们一同下界的势力也跟魔神宗一样，去消耗六十四帝卫，然后我们再坐收渔翁之利”
老者摸着羊胡须笑着道，看着秘境上空上徘徊的乌云，比一个时辰前更加浓厚，已经扩散到了近两公里
随后，如果不出所料，其他两股势力也纷纷进入到了真龙秘境之中
秘境内
content_en:
As Ling Hao transcended the extreme realm, the monks in the entire secret realm rushed to where Ling Hao was. Even some enlightened monsters also rushed in the direction of Ling Hao.
And in the center of the secret lake
Ye Chen always looked in the direction of Ling Hao, his face full of doubts, but he couldn't find the reason why he was so unhappy with this movement, and even felt jealous.
"God, you said this is a phenomenon that only occurs when I break through the extreme realm. Then will a similar phenomenon happen when I break through the extreme realm of Qi refining period?"
Ye Chen looked at Tian Laodao next to him
"Yes, but this is far from enough, because we still need to overcome the tribulation, the Purple Thunder Divine Tribulation."
Tianlao looked into the depths of the secret realm and said
"Purple Thunder Divine Tribulation?"
Ye Chen felt a little timid after hearing this, and then looked at the hundred-foot-long golden light deep in the secret realm that shot straight into the sky.
The Purple Thunder Divine Tribulation is a catastrophe of ten thousand ways. There are nineteen Purple Thunders in total. Each purple thunder contains a kind of great law. Each time it falls, the power increases by one point. If you survive this tribulation, your future will be limitless. If you cannot survive it, your body will die and the Tao will disappear forever. There will be no reincarnation for eternity. Geniuses who can cause the Purple Thunder Divine Tribulation are among the best in the three thousand worlds.
At this time, thick dark clouds began to gather in the void outside the secret realm. The dark clouds were accompanied by purple thunder and lightning, which kept roaring in the dark clouds.
Because Ling Hao is in a secret realm, the Purple Thunder Tribulation cannot break in, and cannot sense Ling Hao's position. He can only continue to gather in the void, waiting for Ling Hao to appear.
Deep in the secret realm
Ling Hao sat cross-legged, his whole body exuding golden light, like the son of the sun. The ancient ancestral dragon on the side looked at the unused heavenly materials and earthly treasures on the ground, so he put them into the storage ring. Although it was of no use, it could not be wasted.
"Looking at Xiao Qinglian's appearance, she has stabilized."
The ancient ancestral dragon looked at Ling Haodao who was sitting cross-legged, and walked towards the outside of the cave.
"You should pay attention to the situation around you. Xiao Qinglian is currently stabilizing her foundation. She cannot be disturbed by anyone. If anyone disturbs her, she will be killed directly."
The Ancient Ancestral Dragon looked at the Sixty-Four Emperor Guards in front of him, his eyes full of killing intent. Now that he recognized Ling Hao as his master, he must ensure Ling Hao's safety. No matter who it was, he would kill him.
"Yes"
The Sixty-Four Emperor Guards nodded. Originally, the Sixty-Four Emperor Guards did not need to obey the orders of the Ancient Ancestral Dragon. However, according to the current situation, in order to ensure Ling Hao's safety, they only temporarily obey the orders of the Ancient Ancestral Dragon.
On the other side, Bai Ze stood solemnly, ready to fight at any time. Anyway, with the sixty-four emperor guards here, just one person can crush any monk in the secret realm.
Outside the secret realm
Seven monks appeared in an instant. Each monk exuded a terrifying aura, accompanied by a terrifying evil spirit. They were not possessed by the Zhenwu Continent at all, as if they were outsiders.
"Lord Hall Master, according to the reliability of the news, the Ling family's divine son and the sixty-fourth imperial guard are inside, and there has just been a lot of movement inside. I am afraid that the dark clouds in the sky were caused by that movement."
A man wearing a black robe knelt down on one knee and said, and in front of him stood a majestic middle-aged man. He exuded the pressure of crushing the void. The black and purple armor made him look even more terrifying. He was the Seven-Killing Leader of the Demon God Sect of the Three Thousand Worlds, Shalong Tian.
"Okay, okay, today is the day the Ling family's divine son dies."
Sha Longtian smiled darkly, his eyes full of desire for blood, and the evil spirit on his body instantly enveloped the surrounding area.
"Let's go in"
Then Shalongtian took the lead to enter the secret realm, and the six people behind him also followed Shalongtian into the secret realm.
On the top of a mountain a few kilometers away, there are thirteen monks wearing blue and white robes. The aura exuding from their bodies is also extremely powerful. However, the old man who leads him has no aura on his body, just like a mortal.
They are the Qingxia Guards of Qingxiao Immortal Palace.
"Elder Qing, the people from the Demon God Sect have entered the secret realm, should we follow closely?"
A man wearing a blue and white Taoist robe bowed and said
"We are not in a hurry. Our ancestors, the Demon God Sect, will consume the strength of the sixty-four imperial guards, and then let the forces that are in the lower world with us also consume the sixty-four imperial guards like the Demon God Sect, and then we will reap the benefits."
The old man stroked his goat's beard and said with a smile, looking at the dark clouds hovering over the secret realm. They were thicker than an hour ago and had spread to nearly two kilometers.
"Yes"
Then, as expected, the other two forces also entered the True Dragon Secret Realm.
